scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,GATEWAY,CATALOG,CART,ORDER,USER "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:catalog" "npm run dev:cart" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:user"
scripts.build: npm run build:services && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.build:services: npm --workspace services/catalog-service run build && npm --workspace services/cart-service run build && npm --workspace services/order-service run build && npm --workspace services/user-service run build && npm --workspace services/api-gateway run build
